Description.doc:definition: Defines a scheme of settlement rate options specified in the 2026 FX Definitions Settlement Rate Options Matrix and, for deprecated values, the Annex A to the 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. The codes correspond to their respective ISDA/EMTA Settlement Rate Option only in the context of a transaction incorporating the corresponding contractual definitions.
Description.doc:confidentiality: This document contains only public information.
Description.doc:disclaimer: The Settlement Rate Option Provider column identifies the body that publishes the rate, without prejudice to the ability of the parties to use any other publication source or service that makes the Spot Rate available, as agreed by the parties.

Description.doc:field: The unique string identifying the Settlement Rate Option, in the form DEFINED.TERM/SROCODE, e.g. CNY.SAEC/CNY01

Does not provide the actual Settlement Rate Option definition, but rather points the user to the place where the definition can be found, e.g. Per the 2026 FX Definitions Settlement Rate Options Matrix, as amended through the date on which parties enter into the relevant transaction.
